name: binary_overview
description: Return the bound document and exhaustive procedure/string counts, plus every segment and segment_count when the provider supports segment enumeration. If segment fields are omitted, segment coverage is unavailable rather than empty. When every observed segment agrees on an analysis image base, return it as image_base so callers can relate provider addresses to their loader coordinates. Use search_procedures, list_procedures, or analyze_function directly when you already know which procedure to inspect.
